review.verdict: The idea (safety report in one hand, trillion-dollar rocket in the other) is coherent and kind, but rendering bugs — an unreadable overlapped warning tag, a near-invisible money bag, and a podium that fuses into the official's body — plus a repetitive datacenter-and-two-figures layout keep this from publishable polish.
revisionNotes: The CATASTROPHIC tag is nearly swallowed by the SAFETY REPORT tag — separate them: drop the warn-tag further down the rocket's tail (rotate -8 kept) and raise safety-label's anchor so there is clear whitespace between the two labels.

The money-bag prop attached to the founder is essentially invisible, hidden behind the official's arm — scale money-bag to 1.3 and increase its offset to the left so the coin and sack silhouette clears the other figure.

The official-podium raw shape fuses into a shapeless hump on the official's back instead of reading as a lectern — move it further to the right side with more gap and keep the counter higher than the shoulder so it reads as a separate object.
The rocket floats with a visible gap above the datacenter instead of appearing to launch from it — close the gap or add an exhaust/flame shape bridging rocket base to roofline.

Composition leaves large dead zones at top (beige sky) and bottom (plain teal ground) while all props crowd the middle band — rebalance by lowering the rocket's apex scale slightly and adding a touch of ground detail (shadow, step) under the figures.

This beige building + two stick-figure humans + chart/arrow arrangement repeats a layout used in several recent sloppers — vary the framing (e.g., diagonal split or different anchor points) to feel fresher.
